ObjectName.value: Argentine Tirabuzón Molto pasta stew with minced meat sauce

Categories.value: Fusilli|Self-published work|Soups and stews of Argentina|Uploaded with Mobile/Android|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Pasta dishes of Argentina|Cuisine of Misiones Province|Photographs taken on 2026-07-11

ImageDescription.value:
A plate of traditional Argentine-style pasta stew (guiso de fideos), featuring Tirabuzón (corkscrew/fusilli) pasta made from durum wheat semolina by the local brand Molto.
​The noodles are mixed with a homemade sauce made of minced meat (beef), tomatoes, chopped onions, garlic, cooking oil, salt, and sweet red paprika (pimentón rojo dulce). This portion is served without grated cheese, positioned on a dining table with a fork, a spoon, and a knife handle visible on the sides.
